about.text: I'm a Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in South Korea. I design and build web services end to end, from Next.js and TypeScript frontends to NestJS, GraphQL and MongoDB backends, deployed with Docker and NGINX. I don't treat full-stack and AI separately: I connect them inside one working service.

hero.text: I'm Azamjon — a Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in South Korea. I build web services end to end and connect them with AI to solve real business problems.

who.story1: I grew up in Uzbekistan and studied engineering. What pulled me in was never the theory, but the moment a real problem finally gets solved. Software turned out to be the fastest way to keep having that moment, so I started building, and I never stopped.
who.story2: Today I work across full-stack development and AI. Alongside it, I'm doing a master's in finance, because I want to understand not only how products are built, but why they matter to the people and businesses using them.
who.principle1Text: I start from the real problem, not from the technology I'd like to use.
who.principle2Text: From the first idea to the live server, I finish what I start.
who.principle3Text: Clear solutions that others can read, use and build on.
who.principle4Text: Every project teaches me something, and I make sure to take it.
who.nextText: To keep growing as an engineer, and to build and take part in projects that make a real difference for people.
who.photoAlt: Azamjon smiling in a warmly lit café

journey.intro: From an engineering degree to building full-stack and AI products: the steps that shaped how I work.
journey.bachelorPoint1: Electrical engineering, electromechanics and electrical technology (railway transport). Qualified as an Electromechanical Engineer in June 2024.
journey.bachelorPoint2: Where solving real problems first pulled me in, and where I started building software professionally in June 2023.
journey.itcPoint1: Built Next.js and TypeScript frontends with NestJS backends.
journey.itcPoint2: Designed REST and GraphQL APIs with JWT auth and Mongoose data models.
journey.itcPoint3: Deployed on Linux VPS with PM2 and NGINX.
journey.ngroupPoint1: Built full-stack apps with Next.js, NestJS and GraphQL, role-based access and real-time WebSocket features.
journey.ngroupPoint2: Fine-tuned PyTorch image classifiers, served them with FastAPI and integrated the Gemini API.
journey.ngroupPoint3: Deployed web and AI services with Docker and NGINX on Ubuntu.
journey.injePoint1: Master's degree in Financial Management at Inje University, South Korea.
journey.injePoint2: Adding business and financial thinking to my engineering.
journey.futurePoint1: Keep growing as an engineer, across full-stack development and AI.
journey.futurePoint2: Build and take part in projects that make a real difference for people.
journey.quote2: learning, building, and creating greater impact.
